title: Subscriptions
subtitle: Monitor and manage company subscriptions and manual payments
assign_title: Assign a plan to a company
confirm_cancel: Cancel immediately? The company loses access except the subscription page.
expiring_soon: Expiring within 7 days — reach out before they lapse
assign_company_search: Search companies by name or email...
duplicate_payment: Already registered earlier — no duplicate created
reactivate_hint: The account regains access immediately until the chosen period ends — available even after expiry or cancellation.
history_page_subtitle: Every version of this company's subscriptions, newest first
history_no_company: No company selected — open a ledger from the History button next to an account in the list
acc_no_company: No account selected — go back to the subscriptions list and pick one
acc_no_sub: No governing subscription — assign a plan from the subscription tab
acc_no_payments: No payments recorded for this account
ov_explainer: Overrides apply to THIS account only, on top of its plan baseline: grant or deny a module/permission, or tweak a numeric limit — no new plan needed, other subscribers untouched. Granting a feature bundles its derived permissions automatically; deleting it falls everything back to the baseline.
ov_empty: No overrides — the account runs on its plan baseline as-is
ov_add_title: Add an override for this account
ov_add_hint: The override replaces the plan setting for this key only; everything else stays from the plan
ov_expires: Expiry date (optional — the override reverses itself)
ov_bundle_hint: This account will receive the feature bundled with {n} derived permissions automatically
ov_confirm_delete: Delete this override and fall back to the plan baseline?
ov_invalid_value: The limit value must be a positive number or -1 for unlimited
log_empty: No events recorded for this account yet
